body: Fake #49ers player Daejon Love allegedly sent women another video claiming he owned a $15M Malibu beach house, a $20M Beverly Hills home, a Miami beach house, and a Billionaire’s Row penthouse in Manhattan. He then showed off what he claimed were nearly $1 MILLION worth of car keys, including a Lamborghini, Corvette ZR1, Hellcat Redeye and Mercedes-AMG. Love also claimed he owned hundreds of thousands of dollars in jewelry, including a $300K Richard Mille watch.
